categories.name: Events based on the Sun's position

fun_fact: Tomorrow, August 12, brings a total solar eclipse — best viewed from northern Spain, where an estimated 450,000 people are expected to travel. But authorities have warned of a heightened wildfire risk as hundreds of thousands head into the hills and beaches for a better view. Read more [here](https://www.theguardian.com/science/2026/aug/10/spain-tourists-solar-eclipse-increased-wildfires-risk).
